intro.lead: Singer Nanahira is known for her high, character-rich voice. She leads the doujin circle Confetto, with work spanning denpa song and rhythm-game music across both the doujin and commercial scenes.
intro.body: This unofficial fan site lays out her releases from 2008 to today on a single timeline: albums, singles, and guest appearances organized year by year, compiled from public sources such as VGMdb and her official site.
meta.description: A fan-made timeline-based introduction to Nanahira's discography.
